item.title: DBS and Granite Asia partner to launch $110M AI IPO fund for Asia’s next generation companies
item.description: DBS, a Singapore-based bank, and Granite Asia, a multi-asset investment platform, have partnered to launch $110 million artificial intelligence (AI) initial public offering (IPO) fund to to accelerate growth of Asia’s next generation companies.

item.title: Workday appoints tech veteran Yen Yen Tan to APAC International Advisory Board
item.description: Workday, Inc., the enterprise artificial intelligence (AI) platform for managing people, money, and agents, has announced the appointment of Yen Yen Tan to its APAC International Advisory Board (IAB), effective on Monday.

item.title: Anaplan launches AWS Data Center in Singapore
item.description: Anaplan, the global artificial intelligence (AI)‑driven scenario planning and analytical firm, has announced the launch of its new Amazon Web Services data center in Singapore.

item.title: Asia Pacific and Japan’s biggest IT challenge isn’t AI, it’s fragmentation
item.description: As AI and cloud-native adoption accelerate, the real differentiator will be how quickly an enterprise's architecture can adapt. Organizations that invest in this adaptability today will be better positioned for whatever comes next.

item.title: Malaysia’s Vynn Capital eyes 2026 with cautious optimism [Q&A]
item.description: We talked to Victor Chua, Founding and Managing Partner at Vynn Capital, to learn more about the VC firm’s achievements in 2025 and its plans and aspirations for 2026. He also shared his views on the outlook of tech ecosystem in Malaysia and Southeast Asia for 2026.

item.title: Singapore’s Eezee raises $5M pre-Series B to expand across Southeast Asia
item.description: Eezee, a Singapore-based based procurement platform focused on enterprise tail-end spend, has raised a $5 million pre-Series B round, led by Korea Investment Partners Southeast Asia, with existing investors such as Kickstart Ventures and Wavemaker Ventures doubling down.

item.title: Singapore’s Diaflow secures seed funding from Insignia Ventures Partners to accelerate AI adoption in business workspaces
item.description: Singapore-headquartered workflow automation platform Diaflow announced Tuesday the completion of its seed funding round led by Insignia Ventures Partners, a venture capital firm in Southeast Asia.

item.title: Peak XV announces $1.3B across three new funds for exceptional founders in India, APAC and beyond
item.description: Peak XV has announced the closing of $1.3 billion in new capital commitments across its India Seed, India Venture, and APAC funds.

item.title: Maybank foresees robust pipeline for Malaysia’s renewable energy contracts
item.description: The project pipeline for utility-scale solar projects remain robust with the upcoming rollout of Corporate Renewable Energy Supply Scheme (CRESS) and large scale solar 6 (LSS6) projects, Maybank Investment Bank said Monday.

item.title: From wire fraud to AI impersonation: Rethinking security architecture in PropTech marketplaces
item.description: Proptech platforms that embed trust as a product feature, enforcing identity checks, payment integrity, and content authenticity within their core architecture, will not just reduce loss; they will strengthen user confidence, compliance posture, and long-term ecosystem credibility.
